## Changeset

Add a changeset if this change should result in a new package version.

- [ ] I have added a changeset
- [ ] No changeset needed

A changeset is needed if the change affects consumers of the design system.

If unsure, it is usually better to include one.

## Conventional Commits

**Tip:** Please use [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/) for your PR title.

Common prefixes:

- `feat:` New functionality
- `fix:` Bug fixes
- `docs:` Documentation changes
- `refactor:` Code changes that neither fix a bug nor add a feature
- `test:` Test changes
- `chore:` Maintenance and tooling changes
- `ci:` CI configuration and workflow changes

Example: `chore: optimize Chromatic snapshot usage`
